description: Search EU public procurement notices on TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) by CPV category, notice type, procedure, contract nature, buyer country, buyer name, publication date, deadline, contract value and keyword, or fetch specific notices by publication number.

buyerName.description: Match notices whose contracting authority name contains this text, e.g. `comune di milano`. Used in `search` mode.
buyerName.title: Buyer Name

contractNature.description: Restrict to works, supplies, or services. Used in `search` mode.
contractNature.title: Contract Nature

country.description: Filter by the buyer's country (ISO-3166 alpha-3, TED style). Used in `search` mode.
country.title: Buyer Country

cpvCategory.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary top-level division. Matches the whole division and all its sub-codes. Used in `search` mode.
enumTitles: 03 - Agricultural, farming, fishing, forestry and related products
09 - Petroleum products, fuel, electricity and other sources of energy
14 - Mining, basic metals and related products
15 - Food, beverages, tobacco and related products
18 - Clothing, footwear, luggage articles and accessories
19 - Leather and textile fabrics, plastic and rubber materials
30 - Office and computing machinery, equipment and supplies (except software)
31 - Electrical machinery, apparatus, equipment and consumables; lighting
32 - Radio, television, communication, telecommunication and related equipment
33 - Medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products
34 - Transport equipment and auxiliary products to transportation
35 - Security, fire-fighting, police and defence equipment
37 - Musical instruments, sport goods, games, toys, handicraft, art materials
38 - Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses)
39 - Furniture, furnishings, domestic appliances (excl. lighting) and cleaning products
43 - Machinery for mining, quarrying, construction equipment
44 - Construction structures and materials; auxiliary products to construction
55 - Hotel, restaurant and retail trade services
63 - Supporting and auxiliary transport services; travel agencies services
71 - Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services
72 - IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support
73 - Research and development services and related consultancy services
75 - Administration, defence and social security services
76 - Services related to the oil and gas industry
77 - Agricultural, forestry, horticultural and related services
79 - Business services: law, marketing, consulting, recruitment, printing, security
90 - Sewage, refuse, cleaning and environmental services
98 - Other community, social and personal services
cpvCategory.title: CPV Category

cpvCode.description: Optional exact or partial CPV code(s) (e.g. `45233140`, `48000000`). Separate several codes with commas or spaces; each matches the code and its sub-codes. Combined with CPV Category. Used in `search` mode.
cpvCode.title: CPV Code(s) (advanced)

deadlineFrom.description: Only notices with a submission deadline on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used in `search` mode.
deadlineFrom.title: Tender Deadline From

deadlineTo.description: Only notices with a submission deadline on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used in `search` mode.
deadlineTo.title: Tender Deadline To

keyword.description: Full-text keyword to match anywhere in the notice (title, description, buyer, ...). Used in `search` mode.
keyword.title: Keyword

maxItems.description: Maximum number of notice records to return (1-10,000).
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxValue.description: Only notices whose total contract value is at most this amount, in the notice's own currency. Used in `search` mode.
maxValue.title: Maximum Contract Value

minValue.description: Only notices whose total contract value is at least this amount, in the notice's own currency. Used in `search` mode.
minValue.title: Minimum Contract Value

mode.description: What to scrape: `search` builds a query from filters; `getNotice` fetches a notice by its publication number.
mode.title: Mode

noticeType.description: Restrict to one TED notice type, e.g. contract notices or contract award notices. Used in `search` mode.
enumTitles: Contract or concession notice - standard regime
Contract or concession award notice - standard regime
Public passenger transport contract award notice
Prior information notice on a buyer profile
Prior information notice to shorten time limits
Prior information notice used as a call for competition - standard
Prior information notice used as a call for competition - light
Prior information notice for public passenger transport
noticeType.title: Notice Type

procedureType.description: Restrict to a procurement procedure, e.g. open or restricted. Used in `search` mode.
enumTitles: Negotiated procedure with prior call for competition
Negotiated procedure without prior call for competition
procedureType.title: Procedure Type

publicationDateFrom.description: Only notices published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used in `search` mode.
publicationDateFrom.title: Published From

publicationDateTo.description: Only notices published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Used in `search` mode.
publicationDateTo.title: Published To

publicationNumber.description: TED publication number(s) to fetch (e.g. `463590-2022`). Accepts several separated by comma/space. Used in `getNotice` mode.
publicationNumber.title: Publication Number

scope.description: Which notices to include: Active (still open for submission), Latest version of each notice, or All notices and versions. Used in `search` mode.
scope.title: Scope

sortBy.description: Order of the returned notices. Used in `search` mode.
sortBy.title: Sort Results By

title: TED Tenders Scraper Input
